none: PAS ESS-5D63D4: An Early Medieval gold tremissis, which has been converted into a pendant, dating to the late 7th century AD.
contea di ritrovamento: Essex (Inghilterra e Galles)

An Early Medieval gold tremissis of Madelinus type imitating the coins minted in Dorestad by the moneyer Madelinus, dating AD 625-675. The coin has been converted into a pendant. Ref: Grierson and Blackburn 1986: nos 493-5; Pol 2010. The obverse depicts a bust in profile, facing right. The inscription reads DRESTATFIT [ Made in Dorestad ].
